title: Finite reduction preserves normalized DNC comparison
statement:
Fix the finite-coefficient purity conventions [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $B=A_{E,m}$ with $1\le m\le n$. Work on the small pro-etale sites in the bounded constructible finite-Tor categories and put $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^LB$. Let $S,V$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $g:V\to S$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$, and $s:S\hookrightarrow V$ a closed section, $gs=\operatorname{id}_S$. Let $\pi_N:N_s\to S$ be its normal bundle with zero section $0_N$ [def-pur-normal-bundle]. For $R=A,B$, use the section invariants [def-pur-section-invariant]
$$C_R(g,s)=Ls^*Rg_R^!R_S,\qquad C_R(\pi_N,0_N)=L0_N^*R\pi_{N,R}^!R_S.$$
Let $\delta_R:C_R(g,s)\xrightarrow\sim C_R(\pi_N,0_N)$ be the unique DNC comparison of [thm-pur-dnc-invariance], normalized as the identity on the standard section invariant in etale coordinates carrying the pair near its section to $(\mathbf A^d_S\to S,0)$. Let $q_{g,s}:Q_SC_A(g,s)\xrightarrow\sim C_B(g,s)$ and $q_N:Q_SC_A(\pi_N,0_N)\xrightarrow\sim C_B(\pi_N,0_N)$ be the composites of the pullback and exceptional coefficient comparisons [lem-fix-operation-reduction, lem-coef-finite-exceptional]. Then
$$q_N\circ Q_S(\delta_A)=\delta_B\circ q_{g,s}.$$
Moreover, etale-locally on $S$, for etale coordinates carrying the pair near its section to the standard pair $(p_d:\mathbf A^d_S\to S,0)$ as in [thm-pur-dnc-invariance], the etale-localization identifications of $C_R(g,s)$ and of $C_R(\pi_N,0_N)$ with $C_R(p_d,0)$, for $R=A,B$, carry both $q_{g,s}$ and $q_N$ to the composite comparison $q_{p_d,0}:Q_SC_A(p_d,0)\xrightarrow\sim C_B(p_d,0)$ of the standard pair, formed in the same way.
